title: Admin service with whitelist, rate limit, audit
desc: Admin check by UserIds or group rank (from a config module), per-admin rate limit, an AllowedCommands whitelist, structured payloads, and an audit log of who ran what.

title: Text console with owner-only wipes
desc: F2 text console backend: tokenizer, partial-name player lookup, give-anything commands that reuse the real grant paths, aliases, help text, owner-only data wipe, cross-server shutdown via MessagingService.

title: F2 console UI (client)
desc: Client side of the console: asks the server if you are an admin, builds a small F2 text box UI, sends the raw line with RunCommand and prints the reply.

title: Command string parser (me/all selectors)
desc: Server handler for a command bar: one RemoteFunction, admin check through a server-set IsAdministrator attribute, me/all/partial-name selectors, kick/ban/teleport/bring/god and more, pcall'd handlers.

title: Panel server: kick/ban/freeze/troll
desc: Remote functions for an admin panel: player list, kick, DataStore ban/unban checked on join, freeze that survives respawn, fun actions (ragdoll, spin, invisible, spectate), per-admin cooldown.

title: Commands as ModuleScripts with required ranks
desc: Each command is a ModuleScript (title, parameters, RequiredRank, AllowedInVIP, Executed); the server sends only the commands your rank allows and re-checks the rank on execute; private-server owners get VIP-safe commands.

title: Conch console: one module per command
desc: Loads every ModuleScript in a Commands folder into the Conch console, gives the super-user role to permitted players and sends them the command list.

title: Permission check: user ids or group rank
desc: hasPermission(player): true if the UserId is in Config.AllowedUserIds or the player's rank in Config.GroupId is at least MinGroupRank.

title: Panel server: one handler per remote
desc: Admin panel backend with one function per remote (spawn items, start/end events locally or globally, announcements, private-server tools, youtuber tags), each starting with an isAdmin check, plus player resolving by id or name.

title: AdminPermissions (levels from owner/group/ids)
desc: Resolves Player/VIP/Moderator/Admin/Owner from game owner, group ranks, your own UserId list and private-server ownership; caches it and mirrors an AdminLevel attribute.

title: AdminCommands (safe text commands)
desc: Command registry with levels, typed args (player/players/number/string), me/all/others selectors, rate limit, admin-only audit log, built-in help/kick/ban/unban/announce using the Roblox Ban API.
